summary: XPeng Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited second-quarter 2026 financial results. The filing includes operational highlights such as total vehicle deliveries of 103,295 and revenue of RMB19.74 billion, a 51.5% increase quarter-over-quarter. Gross margin was 20.7%, and net loss was RMB1.34 billion. No corporate transaction, strategic review, or special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic earnings announcement, not a special-situation event, and does not require further analysis.
